task.title: Viewing X-Author for Contracts Advanced Templates

step.cmd: In the Apps menu under the Shared Apps section, select Conga Drive. Under Conga Templates is alist of stored Templates. Each template record displays the template type, file type, status, sharing rules, and the last updated date.

note.p: The sharing status defaults to Public. Private status is not available at this time.

step.cmd: Use the Search function to find a particular uploaded template record.
Use the checkboxes to select multiple files and export the information listed as CSV or Excel files.

step.info:
icon for the following options:
Preview - Opens the document as a preview window for review, or to print or download the template.
Download - Downloads the template to your local machine.
Delete - Removes the Template from storage and deletes the template record.
Copy Template ID - Copies the ID of the template record to your machines local clipboard.
